content: रागिन् {%a.%} [राग-इनि] .²1 Coloured, dyed. .²2 Colouring, painting. .²3 Red. .²4 Full of passion or feeling, impassioned; रागिणापि विहिता तव भक्त्या <ls>Ki. 18. 27</ls>. .²5 Full of love, subject to love. .²6 Passionately fond of, devotedly attached to, desirous of, yearning after (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुः <ls>Bg. 18. 27</ls>. .²7 Delighting, rejoicing. --{%m.%} .²1 A painter. .²2 A lover; एको रागिषु राजते प्रियतमादेहार्धहारी हरः <ls>Bh. 3. 121</ls>. .²3 A libertine, sensualist. .{@-णी@} .²1 A modification of a musical mode (राग), of which 30 or 36 kinds are enumerated. .²2 A wanton and intriguing woman, a lustful woman.
